name: Mama Shibori 3 no Jijou
source: The protagonist of this story is the son of the protagonist from the previous work, and he is worried that he too will suffer from the same condition as his father - hyperspermia. One day, he finds an erotic book in his sister's room, which causes his genitalia to enlarge. Soon, his mother finds out and takes him to the hospital, where he is diagnosed with hyperspermia. The treatment prescribed is to release more sperm. The mother and sister do everything they can to help him, and even the mother of his classmate and a female doctor at the hospital assist him.
translation: 本作主人公是前作主人公的儿子，他担心自己也会患上与父亲相同的疾病——精液过多症。某天，他在妹妹房间里发现了一本色情书，导致自己的生殖器变大。很快，母亲发现了此事，带他去医院检查，结果被诊断为精液过多症。医生开出的治疗方法是释放更多精液。母亲和妹妹竭尽所能帮助他，甚至同学的母亲与医院里的女医生也出手相助。
